concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) introduces a Phase 0.5 step to generate IR spectra in‑house when the external IR dataset’s DFT method does not match B3LYP. No corresponding task exists in tasks.md to perform this generation, leaving a required pipeline step undocumented and unexecutable.

Constitution Principle I mandates that random seeds be pinned to ensure reproducibility, yet no task in tasks.md explicitly sets or records fixed random seeds for data splitting, model training, or any stochastic operation. A dedicated task (e.g., “Set and record random seeds for all stochastic components”) is required.
